episodes.name: Apollo 15: In the Mountains of the Moon

episodes.name: Apollo 16: Nothing So Hidden
episodes.summary: Young and Duke explore the Descartes highlands by rover while Mission Control and scientists follow every step.

episodes.name: Apollo 17: On the Shoulders of Giants

sherlock-holmes-1954.title: Sherlock Holmes
sherlock-holmes-1954.tagline: The game is afoot, every week.

episodes.name: The Case of the Laughing Mummy
